failingTests: task 1: hasDifficulty matches only the exact difficulty, without var or loose equality
task 2: byDistance is an arrow-function callback and sortTrails returns a new sorted array
task 3: easyTrailNames keeps only easy trails and never mutates the input
task 4: totalDistance uses reduce with an explicit initial value
task 5: describeTrail destructures with a default and withTag copies instead of mutating
task 6: format.mjs exports formatKm (named) and formatTrailLine (default), used by trailLines
task 7: makeTrailLog returns a closure with its own private count

cleanup.notes: The lab creates no files, folders or databases: there are no dependencies to install and the tests only read the starter files. Resetting the learner's work means copying starter/report.mjs and starter/format.mjs back from a fresh copy of the lab. The expected output file writes the variable timings as <ms>. The 68-minute cap is the S23 lab-block planning allowance, not a measured learner pilot. Tasks are behavior-tested with the tests' own frozen fixture data; tasks 1, 2 and 4 additionally check the starter source for the taught style (no var, no loose equality, an arrow callback, reduce) after stripping comments and strings.
